definitions.gloss: top rank; first place; head of a class or group
definitions.explanation: The highest-ranking position in an academic class, examination, or organizational hierarchy.

definitions.gloss: chief; head (of a diplomatic mission or organization)
definitions.explanation: The leading member of a group, especially in diplomatic or governmental contexts.

examples.japanese: {首席|しゅせき}で{卒業|そつぎょう}した。
examples.english: I graduated at the top of my class.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}で{首席|しゅせき}を{取|と}るのが{目標|もくひょう}だ。
examples.english: My goal is to rank first on the exam.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{音楽大学|おんがくだいがく}を{首席|しゅせき}で{卒業|そつぎょう}し、{海外|かいがい}の{有名|ゆうめい}なオーケストラに{入|はい}った。
examples.english: She graduated top of her class from music college and joined a famous orchestra abroad.

examples.japanese: {首席|しゅせき}{代表|だいひょう}が{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: The chief representative attended the meeting.

examples.japanese: {首席|しゅせき}{交渉官|こうしょうかん}が{声明|せいめい}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The chief negotiator issued a statement.

examples.japanese: {大使館|たいしかん}の{首席|しゅせき}{公使|こうし}が{代理|だいり}として{式典|しきてん}に{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: The minister-counselor attended the ceremony as a representative of the embassy.

notes:
Composed of {首|しゅ} (head, chief) + {席|せき} (seat, position). The word carries a strong connotation of being the best or highest-ranking. In academic contexts it means graduating at the very top; in organizational contexts it means the chief or leading member.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首席|しゅせき}で{卒業|そつぎょう}する: to graduate at the top of the class
- {首席|しゅせき}{合格者|ごうかくしゃ}: top-scoring passer
- {首席|しゅせき}{代表|だいひょう}: chief representative
- {首席|しゅせき}{交渉官|こうしょうかん}: chief negotiator

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {主席|しゅせき}: chairman, president — a homophone with different kanji; refers to the leader of an organization or state
- {次席|じせき}: second place, runner-up — the position just below {首席|しゅせき}
- トップ: top — a loanword used more casually for first place
